name: Off-Highway Electric Motorcycle
description: An electric motorcycle only permitted in designated OHV areas or on private property; never on streets, sidewalks, bike lanes, bike paths or highways. Can't be registered or converted for street use. No limit on power or speed.

restrictions.rule: Designed by the manufacturer primarily for off-highway use, with two wheels, handlebars, a straddle seat and no pedals from the manufacturer
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §436.1, added by SB 586 (2025)

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed
Not an electric bicycle or moped, whatever its power, and can't be sold or labeled as an electric bicycle; adding pedals doesn't make it one
Identified with a California OHV Green Sticker from the DMV to ride on public lands, or on private land open to the public
Ridden only in designated OHV areas or on private property; never on highways, streets, sidewalks, bike lanes or bike paths
Can't be registered or converted for street use
No driver's license needed off the highway; riding it on a highway is unregistered, unlicensed operation
